angle: 借谷歌拟/承诺向 Anthropic 最高投入 400 亿美元这条新闻，写清前沿模型竞争背后正在形成云厂商、芯片、算力、股权和客户入口捆绑的供血同盟。
thesis: 这笔钱最值得看的不是估值，而是前沿模型公司开始把算力、云、股权和客户关系绑成供血同盟，AI 竞争正在从“谁模型强”转向“谁能长期供电”。

evidence_anchors.title: Google investing up to $40 billion in Anthropic, the company behind Claude
evidence_anchors.source_type: verified source page; tech media summarizing Bloomberg and Anthropic statement
evidence_anchors.confidence: high for transaction outline; medium for unreleased performance-target detail
key_points: Bloomberg reported Google is investing $10B in Anthropic now, with another $30B if performance targets are hit.
Article states Anthropic said Google is committing $10B cash at a $350B valuation, with another $30B conditional on performance targets.
The investment is framed as supporting a significant expansion of Anthropic computing capacity.
Anthropic is already a major Google Cloud customer and has a recent Google/Broadcom TPU capacity deal.

evidence_anchors.title: Anthropic expands partnership with Google and Broadcom for multiple gigawatts of next-generation compute
key_points: Anthropic says it signed a new agreement with Google and Broadcom for multiple gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity, expected to come online starting in 2027.
Anthropic CFO Krishna Rao describes it as the company’s most significant compute commitment to date.
The statement says run-rate revenue has surpassed $30B, up from about $9B at the end of 2025, and $1M+ annualized-spend customers have doubled from over 500 to over 1,000 in less than two months.
Anthropic says it trains and runs Claude across AWS Trainium, Google TPUs and NVIDIA GPUs; Amazon remains primary cloud provider/training partner.

evidence_anchors.title: Expanding our use of Google Cloud TPUs and Services
key_points: Anthropic announced plans to expand Google Cloud technology usage, including up to one million TPUs.
The expansion is worth tens of billions of dollars and expected to bring well over a gigawatt of capacity online in 2026.
Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian says Anthropic’s TPU expansion reflects price-performance and efficiency seen over several years.
Anthropic describes a diversified compute strategy across Google TPUs, Amazon Trainium and NVIDIA GPUs.

evidence_anchors.title: 谷歌承诺向Anthropic投资至多400亿美元
evidence_anchors.source_type: verified Chinese repost/summary from 观点网 via 腾讯新闻; secondary
evidence_anchors.confidence: medium-high for Chinese wording; should attribute to 观点网/公开资料 rather than treat as primary
key_points: 中文报道口径：4月26日，Alphabet 承诺向 Anthropic 投资至多 400 亿美元，以支持大幅扩展运算能力。
口径为立即 100 亿美元现金，若达到业绩目标再追加 300 亿美元。
估值口径为 3500 亿美元；Anthropic 是谷歌 TPU 芯片和云服务重要客户。
该报道把交易目的明确指向算力规模扩张。

evidence_anchors.title: Anthropic and Amazon expand collaboration for up to 5 gigawatts of new compute
key_points: Anthropic and Amazon signed a new agreement securing up to 5GW capacity for training and deploying Claude.
Anthropic commits more than $100B over ten years to AWS technologies; Amazon invests $5B today with up to an additional $20B in the future, building on $8B previously invested.
Claude Platform will be available directly within AWS; Claude is described as available across AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure.
This supports the article’s frame that cloud, chips, capital and distribution are being bundled.

risks: 不要把 400 亿美元写成已经全部到账；稳妥写法是“最高/至多 400 亿美元”“先 100 亿，后续 300 亿取决于业绩目标”。
不要说 Google 已经取代 Amazon；Anthropic 官方仍称 Amazon 是 primary cloud provider and training partner。更准确是多云、多芯片供血格局被进一步强化。
不要把 Amazon 的 $50B 美国基础设施投资误写成 Amazon 给 Anthropic 的 $50B 股权投资；官方另有 $5B 当前投资 + 最高 $20B 后续投资 + 既有 $8B。
和昨天 DeepSeek-V4 + 昇腾文章区分：昨天重点是国产开源模型的算力/成本/生态总账，今晚重点是闭源前沿模型与云厂商的资本-算力-客户绑定。
避免过度断言监管、独家排他或股权控制权；公开材料更适合支持“供血同盟/基础设施锁定”，不支持写成“Google 控制 Anthropic”。

style_exemplar_pack.voice: 接地气但有判断，把融资数字翻译成普通读者能懂的供血权、插座、机房、电费和客户入口。
desired_moves: 用一个具体场景开头：大家盯着400亿美元，本虾先看它后面接了多少电、多少机房、多少云合同。
把钱解释成算力预付款、云厂商押注和模型公司的长期供电合同，而不是估值八卦。
中段给出可复述判断：模型公司以后拼的不只是哪家脑子聪明，还要拼谁的供血管够粗、够稳、够久。
anti_exemplars: AI 巨头融资新闻汇总
只堆 Google、Amazon、NVIDIA、TPU 名词，不解释对用户和模型竞争意味着什么
复用昨天“算力账摊开了”的结构和句子
